_readme: Reviewed exceptions to the Storybook a11y gate (npm run test:a11y). Each entry waives one axe rule for one story id, in every family and theme. Every field is required and non-empty: storyId (e.g. forms--select), rule (the axe rule id, e.g. color-contrast), reason (why it is acceptable or where it is tracked), owner (who removes it). Adding an entry needs review, the same as a code change.
